description: When the System Fails the People, You Don’t Have to Stay in ItFor too long, working families in Mississippi—and across this country—have been told to settle. Settle for broken promises, for rigged systems, for party politics that serve the powerful and leave everyone else behind. I didn’t come this far—from chopping cotton in the Delta, to fighting in combat zones overseas, to serving in the White House—to accept a system that fails the very people it was meant to serve. I’m not switching sides.

title: Why I’m Leaving the Democratic Party and Running as an Independent
